extra.message: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) vulnerability. User-supplied 'username' parameter from query string is directly concatenated into Jinja2 template string and rendered. An attacker can inject Jinja2 template expressions like {{7*7}} to execute arbitrary Python code, potentially leading to remote code execution (RCE). For example, accessing {{config}} leaks application configuration, or using {{''.__class__.__mro__[2].__subclasses__()}} can achieve RCE. The safe implementation is shown on line 17 which uses template variables with automatic escaping.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
